dialogues.speaker: Bruce
dialogues.text: If you ask me, I don't think it's anything serious.

dialogues.speaker: Bruce
dialogues.text: The Archon War makes Stormterror look like child's play. If you think about it, there haven't been a lot of casualties at all.

dialogues.speaker: Bruce
dialogues.text: In any case, we have our reliable colleagues and our eminent Acting Grand Master. This issue will be solved very soon. Mondstadt won't be in any great danger.
